messages:
sam: deploy-bot reported canary degraded after the values bump — health checks spiking, canary 2/5 pods failing in eu-west-1

deploy-bot: Canary check FAILED: healthy_ratio=0.6 (threshold=0.95). failing_endpoints=[/v1/generate], recent_restarts=2

sam: logs show 503s and restarts tied to liveness probe failures (not OOM).

kelly: looks like probe sensitivity changed with the cpu request bump. which chart + values were applied?

sam: chart=api-server, chart_version=2026.3.2, values changes: cpu.request 250m -> 500m, liveness.initialDelaySeconds 5 -> 2

mira: pinging @andrew for decision: do we pin the release (pause rollout) or rollback to 2026.3.1? change window in ~2h.

andrew: prefer pin (hold the new chart) to minimize blast radius, unless there's a safety reason to rollback. any DB migrations in this release?

sam: no migrations, image digest unchanged — only values/helms.

kelly: two safe options: 1) hotfix values (increase initialDelaySeconds) and resume canary, or 2) rollback helm release to previous revision. Which do we want?

mira: hotfix is less disruptive if it buys us time. can we do a quick patch and re-run the canary checks?

andrew: yes, hotfix first. if canary still fails after 15m, rollback to 2026.3.1 and open rollforward doc.

sam: preparing a minimal patch now — will set liveness.initialDelaySeconds: 10 and leave other values as-is.

sam: ```yaml
# quick liveness patch (apply with --reuse-values)
liveness:
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 500m
```

andrew: deploy-bot, can you apply that patch to the canary and re-run the canary suite? tag it as post-canary hotfix.

deploy-bot: @andrew acknowledged. Running: `helm upgrade api-server --namespace prod --reuse-values -f hotfix-liveness.yaml` then triggering canary-suite.

sam: applying patch now, restarting canary pods (rolling restart will affect 20% of replicas)

deploy-bot: Rollout started. New canary pods reporting: 3/5 ready -> running health checks.

kelly: re-run quick smoke: `curl -fsS https://api.prod/internal/health || echo fail` and post results here.

mira: if failures persist after the 15m observation window we proceed with helm rollback to 2026.3.1 and prepare release note text.

andrew: also capture perf delta and tokenization logs in the ticket #INF-4321. Document decision path (hotfix -> pin -> rollback).

sam: canary smoke returned OK. monitoring shows reduced restart counts and errors trending down. will let it run the 15m window and report. :thumbsup:

mira: cool — if it stays green we pin the chart version for the cohort and add a note to release notes about liveness tuning. Sam, please add the pinned annotation and update the release notes draft.

sam: added annotation to the HelmRelease to prevent further automated promotion, and updated release notes draft: "Post-canary: liveness probe sensitivity increased in 2026.3.2; hotfix applied to increase initialDelaySeconds. Monitoring showed stabilization; rollout held pending further validation."

andrew: thanks — file INF-4321 with links and mark this thread resolved once the 1h sanity passes.

sam: will do, closing on green. :white_check_mark:
